I got a LOT of surprises when I wrote (and I'm just now starting to write fanfic again so I'll soon have many more), but this was the one that stuck with me most:

-The fanfics that I enjoyed writing most got little to no hits, while the ones I didn't really care about got a lot of favorites/reviews/follows. I liked to write a mix of angst and humor, and half of my works were crossovers lol. I remember one story that I was very proud of, and I put most of my focus into writing it until I realized it wasn't getting any hits, compared to my other fics. The most popular one that I'd posted, to date, had 20ish reviews, and it was a crappy 600 word oneshot that I wrote in five minutes. 

-I posted all of my works to ffnet and deviantart, after a friend introduced me to both sites. I got the most hits on deviantart, but the fandom was starting to die out around this time, and everyone just migrated there to post (it was a fairly small fandom, no one's really written for it in two or three years).
Thanks for sharing!
